newsitem.title: USA: Fed watching data that might show strain-Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Fed watching data that might show strain-Greenspan.

text.p: The Federal Reserve, in attempting to gauge whether inflation might become a problem, is looking closely at data that might indicate strain on the economy's productive resources, Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said Tuesday.

Answering a question during his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony, Greenspan listed such indicators as factory overtime, supplier deliveries and "anything which is indicative of issues of strain in the economy."
The central bank is trying to guard against a situation where those kinds of strains could prematurely bring a halt to the U.S. economic expansion, he said.
